title: Grilled Peach Dumplings
description: A sweet and savory twist on traditional Chinese dumplings, featuring tender peaches and a hint of Croatian spice.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced peaches and a pinch of Croatian paprika.
Lay out the dumpling wrappers and place a tablespoon of the peach mixture in the center of each wrapper.
Brush the edges of the wrapper with a little water and fold the wrapper to form a half-moon shape.
Brush the tops of the dumplings with vegetable oil and place them on the grill.
Cook the dumplings for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they're golden brown and caramelized.
Serve the dumplings warm, topped with additional sliced peaches if desired.
